'''Sergio Bertolucci''' (born 1 January 1950) is an Italian [[Particle physics|particle physicist]], and a former director of research and scientific computing at [[CERN]] (''Conseil Européen pour la Recherche Nucléaire'').

==Early life==
He was born in [[La Spezia]]. He studied particle physics at the [[University of Pisa]].<ref>[http://www.treccani.it/enciclopedia/sergio-bertolucci/ Biography]</ref> He did further research at [[DESY]] in Germany.

==Career==
===LNF===
From 2002 to 2004 he worked at the [[Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati]] (LNF), where he was director.<ref>[http://cerncourier.com/cws/article/cern/28634 LNF]</ref>

===INFN===
From 2005 to 2008 he worked at [[Istituto Nazionale di Fisica Nucleare]] (INFN) in Italy.

===CERN===
He served as CERN director of research from 2009 to 2015.
<ref>[https://physicsworld.com/a/fabiola-gianotti-takes-charge-at-cern-as-lab-weighs-up-designs-for-future-colliders/ physicsworld, 4 Jan 2016]</ref>
